summary: Bugbear Entertainment's soft-body demolition racing series, spiritually linked to FlatOut and focused on banger racing, demolition derbies, realistic damage, and modern destruction physics.

entries.title: Wreckfest
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Wreckfest released first on Windows after a long early-access period, then came to PS4, Xbox One, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Stadia, Switch, Android, and iOS. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for Bugbear's soft-body damage racing, with the best settings/mod/preservation path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives and Switch/mobile only for portable access.

entries.remaster_caveats: Google Stadia is no longer a playable route after the service shutdown; use Windows for durable preservation.

entries.title: Wreckfest 2

emulation.notes: Run the Windows Early Access build natively and revisit after full release.

primary.why: Wreckfest 2 entered Steam Early Access on Windows on 20 March 2025. PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S versions have been announced, but their release dates are not yet announced; Windows is therefore the only shipped and highest-fidelity route right now.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows Steam Early Access build, understanding that content and performance may change before the final release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game; content, physics, performance, and final console release status may change before 1.0.
